newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Sept BTP future at new high, spread narrows.
newsitem.headline: Italy Sept BTP future at new high, spread narrows.

text.p: The September futures contract on the Italian Btp on LIFFE hit a new record peak at 133.03 in late European trade.
The yield spread between the benchmark February 2007 Btp and the July 4, 2007 Bund narrowed to a record level of 124 basis points before widening again to 125.
The market has been climbing in afternoon trade and by 1421 GMT the September Btp future had continued climbing and was trading 41 basis points at 132.99 having hit 133.03 moments before.
